# Storm repairs, done quickly

Douglas from Rosyth, who has been with us since 1994, told the Kingdom Gazette that his roof was patched within two days of the weekend's storm. He phoned on the Sunday and a roofer was up the ladder on the Tuesday.

It is a good reminder of what to do when the weather turns. Take photographs of any damage before you start tidying up, because insurers usually ask for pictures when you make a claim.

If rain is getting in, a temporary fix is fine while you wait for a proper repair. Keep receipts for anything you pay for, such as a tarpaulin or an emergency call-out, and do not climb onto a roof yourself. A pair of binoculars from the garden will show you most of what you need to see.
